name: kalmido
description: The calm task app for households and small teams that you own: lists, calendar, shared projects, time tracking, invoices and AI agents with approvals. Self-hosted with Docker Compose and PostgreSQL, free for any number of people. AGPL-3.0.

paragraphs: The task app for households and small teams that you own: personal planning, shared projects and time tracking in one app. Free for any number of people, on your own server.
Lists, calendar, Eisenhower matrix, habits, a focus timer, time tracking, comments and shared lists in one small web app you run yourself.
kalmido.com · Quick start · Updating · Translate · Changelog
features: Free for everyone in the house or team. No per-seat subscription, unlimited users, lists and tasks, and everyone you share a list with works in it for free.

One app instead of three. Tasks, habits, focus timer and real time tracking with rates and timesheets, plus the team essentials: sharing, assignment, comments, activity, a News inbox, dependencies, project status and…
Simple when you want it. Switch Collaboration off and it is a quiet personal list again.

Yours. Runs on your own server, no vendor account, no telemetry (the optional update check only asks GitHub for the latest version number), open source under the AGPL-3.0. Fits a self-hosted setup: single sign-on…
Honest trade-offs. No native apps or widgets (it is an installable web app), no location-based reminders, and no support desk yet.

requirements.text: Try it in your browser: no account, no server, your data stays in your browser.
